<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:NATIVE-035-preview-boundary-batch-20261029 -->

## Resolved in related preview-boundary safety batch

Source: [`64e6c2ed`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/commit/64e6c2edae27b63bd6bcacf2f334ff3935c995d9). This resolves **truthful feature/distribution scope**, not a maps/media/scheduler implementation.

**Important shared verification with #41:** actual configured Gradle model checks exactly21 explicit independent publisher projects/145 publications, maps included without a publisher and no API source, media/scheduler excluded, and no prototype directory reused by any publisher's Kotlin source set. Gradle exit0/63.02s, JDK17,841held inputs proved byte-identical to the source commit; no package or staging task was executed. Four owning source/policy Python checks and four actual version-policy JUnit methods/one fresh XML pass. Accepted results were not replayed.

All original criteria reviewed. The roadmap explicitly retains [maps#27](https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/issues/27) and [media#245](https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/issues/245) as **unimplemented feature requests**, never claims they are fixed, and requires fresh Gradle configuration, implemented API contract, platform privacy/provider setup and native device tests before future enabling/support/publication. Source guards verify that deferred-feature policy and exclusions. Notification **permissions** are not scheduling. Imported feature-request issues remain unchanged/open.

Scope is current source/configured distribution topology and truthful documentation; **not** built/published artifacts, native feature behavior, complete ABI/consumer/dependency/provenance/legal/security or release certification. Packages/releases/deployment/Pages remain gated. Original issue body/title/labels/history preserved. Public receipts will be appended under `docs/development/evidence/preview-boundary-batch-important-20261029/`.
